title: Cartesian exchange of internal compact adjunction
statement: For any Cartesian square of schemes with compactifiable vertical maps f and f-prime and quasi-compact f-prime, and any finite commutative coefficient ring Lambda, the canonical internal compact-adjunction isomorphism Rf_*RHom(N,f!Q) = RHom(Rf!N,Q) commutes with base change: pullback of this isomorphism followed by internal-Hom pullback comparison and precomposition with inverse compact exchange equals ordinary exchange followed by internal-Hom pullback comparison, exceptional exchange, and internal compact adjunction on the base change. N and Q are arbitrary derived complexes. The notation is that of [prop-asd-internal-adjunction] [sbc-def-base-change-map].

proof.text: Cancel invertible compact exchange, tensor comparisons and the inverse pullback-square comparison. The monoidal delta/mu identities and inverse identities turn this equality into compatibility of the left-adjoint projection squares.

Apply compactInternalAdjunctionExchangeOfMateCompatibility. Its proved mate calculation identifies ordinary base change, internal-Hom pullback comparisons, precomposition with inverse compact exchange, and the exceptional mate. The latter is the defining rightDerivedUpperShriekBaseChangeMap. This gives the stated square for arbitrary N and Q.

lean.statement:
theorem compactInternalAdjunctionExchange
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ] [Finite Λ]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}} {f : X ⟶ S} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    {g : S' ⟶ S} {g' : X' ⟶ X}
    [HasCompactification f] [HasCompactification f'] [QuasiCompact f']
    (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g) (N : DerivedCategoryModule Λ X)
    (Q : DerivedCategoryModule Λ S) :
    compactInternalAdjunctionExchangeSquare (ModuleCat Λ) sq.toCommSq
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekBaseChangeMap Λ sq) N Q
      (rightDerivedUpperShriekBaseChangeMap Λ sq)
